castTime.binNote: Bin lists castTime 0.01 for SamiraW, but wiki states 0.1 and notes the cast time has no effect on usability; reporting the wiki's stated number.

values.meaning: duration of the spin, between the two slashes

mechanics.claim: Samira spins her blade over 0.75 seconds, dealing damage twice: the first slash occurs immediately and the second after the duration.
mechanics.quote: '''Samira''' slashes twice during ''Blade Whirl'', each one dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies. The first slash occurs immediately and the second one occurs after the duration.

mechanics.claim: Blade Whirl destroys all hostile non-turret projectiles for its duration, and a spell shield blocks the damage from only one slash.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage from one slash.

mechanics.claim: Samira cannot basic attack or cast Flair during Blade Whirl, and casting Inferno Trigger ends it early (skipping the second slash if not yet resolved).
mechanics.quote: '''Samira''' cannot basic attack nor cast {{ai|Flair|Samira}} during Blade Whirl. Casting {{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}} will end Blade Whirl early.
